name: Confidence-Adaptive KL + Logit-L2 + BN Freeze
tagline: Retain CE + per-sample memorization-weighted KL(uniform || model) on forget + small ||logits||² penalty; BN running stats frozen.
formula:
$$ w_i = 1 + 2\,\mathrm{sg}(p_\theta(y_f | x_i^f)),\;\; \mathcal{L}_{\text{KL}} = \overline{w_i \cdot \mathrm{KL}\big(\tfrac{1}{C}\mathbf{1}\,\|\,p_\theta(\cdot|x_i^f)\big)} $$
$$ \mathcal{L} = \mathrm{CE}(p_\theta, y^r) + \lambda_{KL}\,\mathcal{L}_{\text{KL}} + \lambda_{L^2}\,\overline{\|z(x^f)\|_2^2} $$
$$ \text{During unlearning: BN.eval()  // freeze running mean/var, keep affine learnable} $$

key_hyperparams.name: kl_weight
key_hyperparams.role: weight on KL(uniform || model) over forget batch

key_hyperparams.name: memo_weight_slope
key_hyperparams.role: scale on detached p(y_f|x) in adaptive weight

key_hyperparams.name: bn_running_stats
key_hyperparams.role: prevents forget-batch stats from corrupting BN

diff_from_baseline: Combines retain-finetuning with two forget terms — a KL(uniform||model) re-weighted per sample by detached confidence on the forget class, and a small mean-squared-logit penalty — and switches all BatchNorm modules to eval() so running statistics are not polluted by forget-set batches.

name: Importance-Masked Negative-Grad + Entropy
tagline: Three-way gradient combination: retain CE, sigmoid-importance-masked −forget CE, and entropy-max on forget logits, with EMA-adaptive forget weight.

key_hyperparams.name: forget_weight (base)
key_hyperparams.role: α on the importance-masked negative-CE forget gradient

key_hyperparams.name: entropy_weight
key_hyperparams.role: weight on entropy-maximisation gradient over forget batch

key_hyperparams.name: importance_scale
key_hyperparams.role: sigmoid sharpness on per-parameter importance mask

key_hyperparams.name: ema_alpha
key_hyperparams.role: EMA coefficient on retain loss (used to throttle α)

key_hyperparams.name: ema_thresholds
key_hyperparams.role: retain-loss bands that scale α down to 0.8x / 0.5x

key_hyperparams.name: grad_clip
key_hyperparams.role: per-parameter L2 clip on combined gradient

diff_from_baseline: Generalises the negative_gradient baseline: explicitly forms three separate gradients (retain CE, forget CE, forget entropy), masks the forget gradient by a per-parameter sigmoid of normalized retain-gradient norms, throttles the forget weight by an EMA of retain loss, and adds a fixed entropy-maximisation term.

name: MSE Distillation + Forget-Class Logit Zeroing
tagline: Match the original model's logits via MSE on both retain and forget batches, but with the forget-class logit replaced by 0 in the targets.
formula:
$$ z^*(x) = z_{\bar\theta}(x), \quad z^*(x)_{\,c_f} = 0\quad(\text{forget class}) $$
$$ \mathcal{L} = 5\cdot\mathrm{MSE}\big(z_\theta(x^r),\, z^*(x^r)\big) + 1\cdot\mathrm{MSE}\big(z_\theta(x^f),\, z^*(x^f)\big) $$
init_recovers: exact teacher mimicry at retain_weight ≫ forget_weight if forget_class logit also kept
diff_from_baseline: Replaces SCRUB / bad_teacher KD with a simpler logit-MSE distillation against a frozen original model whose forget-class logit is overwritten with 0; weights heavily favour retention (5x vs 1x) and the forget batch is also distilled (with the zeroed target).

name: Masked-KD Forget + Fisher Damp + PCGrad
tagline: Retain CE+KD, forget KD against teacher target with the forget class masked out (and class-prob suppressed); forget grad damped by Fisher-EMA and projected away from retain.

key_hyperparams.name: teacher_mix
key_hyperparams.role: α blending teacher non-target softmax with uniform

key_hyperparams.name: forget_weight
key_hyperparams.role: base λ_f for combined forget step

key_hyperparams.name: importance_scale
key_hyperparams.role: sigmoid-style damping strength on important params

diff_from_baseline: Goes well beyond SCRUB: retain side is CE+KD@T=2; forget side is KD against a (1-α) uniform + α teacher target with the forget class masked, plus a linear suppressor on p(c_f|x^f). The forget gradient is damped per-parameter by an EMA Fisher-style estimate of retain importance, projected to be non-conflicting with the retain gradient (PCGrad), normalised to ||g_r||/||g_f||, and linearly ramped over the first 4 epochs.
